name: Scout
notes: Published by Outcrawl; the GitHub description calls the repository an automatic mirror of Outcrawl's production repository. Packages: scout (entry point), runtime (agent loop), model (prompts and provider-neutral clients), scout-core, scout-cdp (DevTools-protocol driver) and agenthands (local pointer and keyboard planning). It runs against a local browser, any CDP endpoint or Outcrawl's hosted browser, which needs an Outcrawl key and adds residential connections, captcha solving and replays. The README reports 92.5% page reach on Browser Use's 80-site benchmark. Root code is Apache-2.0; packages/agenthands keeps its own MIT license.
summary: TypeScript browser agent that drives any Chromium over CDP in a look-act-check loop, with separate user-chosen hands, brain, eyes and extract models and optional JSON Schema answers.
